name: InterContinental Singapore Robertson Quay
positioning: Riverfront hotel on the Singapore River in the Robertson Quay district, set in a lively food precinct, with light-filled rooms that have a warm, residential feel, a 4th-floor outdoor pool, a Club lounge overlooking the quay and complimentary bikes for exploring the river
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base with restaurants and bars at the doorstep
Guests who like to explore the city by bike or run along the river
City travelers who want Orchard Road, Marina Bay and the CBD close by

facts.text: The hotel sits along the Singapore River in the Robertson Quay district.
Orchard Road, Marina Bay and the CBD are moments away from the hotel.
The light-filled studios and suites blend elegance with a warm, residential feel.
Club InterContinental gives access to a private lounge overlooking Robertson Quay.
The outdoor swimming pool is on the 4th floor.
Complimentary Tokyo Bikes are available for exploring Robertson Quay, the Singapore River and neighbourhoods beyond.
The Quay Insider program helps guests discover Robertson Quay through a local lens.
The riverfront area next to the hotel is a popular running route.
The hotel is in a lively food precinct with restaurants and bars at the doorstep.
Publico Ristorante & Garden serves wood-fired pizzas and house-made pastas by the Singapore River.

considerations.text: Rooms can be smaller than expected.
The gym is small, though the riverfront next to the hotel is a popular running route.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting has a city hotel atmosphere rather than a resort feel.
